name: Phenylalanine
info: A nonpolar aromatic side chain. A precursor of tyrosine.

history.story: “Phenylalanine” combines the words “phenyl” and “alanine” and describes the –CH₂–C₆H₅ side chain. In 1961, this amino acid helped decode the genetic code: in Nirenberg and Matthaei's experiment, RNA made of repeating U residues directed the synthesis of a phenylalanine chain. This established the meaning of the UUU codon.
